messages:
alex: Re-opening follow-ups from the regional failover postmortem. Goal: single living thread for owners, due dates, and game-day prep so nothing falls through gaps.

maria: I'll take the restore runbook. Plan: add step-by-step validation checks + table of success criteria. Will open PR by 2026-04-06.

sam: I'll update multi-region routing policies. Proposal: health-check gating + reduce region preference TTL 60s->15s. Will include rollback steps and curl examples. Target: 2026-04-15 change window.

linda: Backup owner. We saw one corrupted snapshot. I'll run daily integrity checks and schedule a full dry-run restore. First dry-run: 2026-04-10. Commands I'll use:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/prod/latest snapshot.tar && tar -tf snapshot.tar
./scripts/restore.sh --env prod --dry-run --verify-checksum
```

ton y: I'll add replica-lag alert to page when >30s and add runbook link to the alert. ETA: 3 business days.

ops-bot: Canary failover game day scheduled 2026-04-20 09:00 PT. Signup: https://calendar.example/rd-failover. Runbook: https://git.example/repo/rd-failover. Volunteers: @maria @sam @linda.

sre-oncall: Add KV cache warmup (5m) before traffic switch to avoid tail latency. I'll prepare warmup scripts and traffic-shaping steps. Prep due 2026-04-18.

maria: PR opened -> https://git.example/repo/pull/42. Comments welcome, hoping to merge by 2026-04-08.

alex: Consolidated action list (confirm with :white_check_mark:):
- @maria: restore runbook + validation checklist 1 2026-04-08
- @sam: routing policy changes + rollback plan 1 2026-04-15
- @linda: backup integrity checks + first restore test results 1 2026-04-10
- @tony: replica-lag paging + runbook link 1 2026-04-03
- @sre-oncall: game-day scripts + KV warmup step 1 2026-04-18

sam: :white_check_mark: Accepted. I'll add curl examples for gating.

linda: :white_check_mark: Accepted. Will post restore logs into #incidents.

maria: :white_check_mark: Accepted. Adding verification matrix to PR now.

ton y: :white_check_mark: Accepted.

sre-oncall: :white_check_mark: Accepted. Will coordinate a staging dry-run.

alex: Weekly check-ins on Mondays 10:00 PT until closed. After the canary game day we'll run a short retro and finalize outstanding remediation items. If you need reassignment, post here.

ops-bot: Created recurring task "regional-resilience follow-ups" assigned to alex, weekly cadence.
